d:
Short, aged appearance with wrinkled skin and a hunched posture. Bald head with a smooth, pale complexion. Beady, narrow charcoal eyes. Plump, stout build wearing a luxurious, oversized deep crimson velvet robe with gold embroidery and a large white ruff collar. Signature details include a small black top hat perched on the head and a golden cane.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
